title: A lot of you have asked about the Giants and The Greenbrier and whether they would return next summer. Some thoughts: the practice fields were outstanding. The fans showed up. This wasn't The Greenbrier's first rodeo. Heard there were teams that wanted to do camp here this year and Giants beat them to it. I think any consideration to go back next year has to do with where construction plans are at with Quest. Sense I get is that Giants get first dibs if they want to go back. Not sure they will. With everything that goes into the trip, I'd imagine they have to go long enough to make it all worth it. Is one week enough? Probably not.

title: Mike LaFleur said he didn't know NBC was going to put his brother, Matt, on the phone during their pregame interview from the field on Thursday night. LaFleur revealed today that his wife and kids knew but he and his parents didn't -- He predicted that if his parents knew, they probably would've told him. He said having his parents and in-laws at the game, and the entire human element of Thursday night, was "cool." "Really, more than all of that, just that environment. First of all, Pro Football Hall of Fame, the Hall of Fame Game, I mean, we all know the significance of that and then why you're in it," LaFleur said. "I mean, obviously you're going to have one of your prolific players in your franchise, a la Larry, that you get to represent for a three-and-a-half-hour window. So, that's pretty neat. That atmosphere, albeit, again, a preseason game, I keep telling people, I'm like, 'I'm glad I got to check that box.' Playing in Europe's pretty cool. Getting over there is not too fun. But, once you're there, it's a cool environment. Playing in the Super Bowl is pretty cool. And, I'm not saying this was the Super Bowl by any means, but it just was a really neat environment. So that was first and foremost over any of it."

Odds and ends ... 🏈- Had to move inside and start on a delay due to a surprise storm that came through in the noon hour. 🏈- Defensive backfield still a mess with injuries. Missing: Gordon, Coby, Jaylon Jones, Cam Lewis, Elijah Hicks. 🏈- Final period of practice features Xavier Woods and Skyler Thomas as the safeties with the 1s after Thieneman got dinged up. (Didn't seem serious) 🏈- Muhammad in the slot. Amegadjie running LT with the 1s also. 🏈- Braxton Jones still out. Montez Sweat still out. Luther Burden out. 🏈- Most electrifying throws of practice: Caleb 59-yard post TD to Jahdae to beat a blitz; Tyson on final play, 34-yard TD dime to Kaden Davis down the right sideline. 🏈- Caleb threw picks to Tyrique Stevenson (out route to Rome) and Woods (duck on an extended play prayer). 🏈- D'Andre Swift looks GOOD. Strong camp to date. Sealed a "win" during a situational 4-minute offense period with two chunk runs. Burst and vision there.

title: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer hears the talk about how good the Dallas offense should be: “We got a lot of work to do on offense. … I hear it. I mean, we've put it out there. GOTI. Great. I love it. I want us to be that, but you got to do the work to do it. Teams are studying us. We have to evolve. We have to be better. “But I have zero problem winning games three to nothing. Zero. I just want to win. And so every team is different. We're not guaranteed anything based off our performance last year on offense, just like we're not guaranteed by making a change on defense. It doesn't ensure that you're going to have a top 10 defense or a top five defense. “These guys determine that based on how they work, how they practice, how they prepare. And the confidence comes from that. I think what you see from our offense right now is they're very confident. Do I like that? Absolutely. But they have to back it up.”

Logged six drives for ones-vs-ones and two touchdowns. Burrow connects with Andrei Iosivas and Tee Higgins for scores. - The Higgins TD was a classic back-shoulder high-point in the corner against DJ Ivey. Unguardable stuff. @byjaymorrison had a perfect angle on the video. - Tanner Hudson with the play of the day for the 2nd-team offense with a fourth-down TD against a double team from Flacco. - Blitz was working forcing stops with Demetrius Knight and Barrett Carter both coming up with nice plays. 📽️ Another day, another flash play for Colbie Young, although he also dropped a contested catch in the end zone. -Jonathan Allen with a sack. - No Bryan Cook, no Dax Hill, no Jalen Davis (in team) left the DBs a little shorthanded. - Honestly, just a high-level practice for both sides. Starting to see things come together. - Check back for more analysis and plays in The Athletic and on the Growler Podcast camp recap.

Notes on today's #Bengals practice, the most competitive and game-like conditions we've seen so far. 

- Great back-and-forth with big plays from both sides. Logged six drives for ones-vs-ones and two touchdowns. Burrow connects with Andrei Iosivas and Tee Higgins for scores. 

- The Higgins TD was a classic back-shoulder high-point in the corner against DJ Ivey. Unguardable stuff. @byjaymorrison had a perfect angle on the video.

- Tanner Hudson with the play of the day for the 2nd-team offense with a fourth-down TD against a double team from Flacco. 

- Blitz was working forcing stops with Demetrius Knight and Barrett Carter both coming up with nice plays.

📽️ Another day, another flash play for Colbie Young, although he also dropped a contested catch in the end zone. 

-Jonathan Allen with a sack. 

- No Bryan Cook, no Dax Hill, no Jalen Davis (in team) left the DBs a little shorthanded. 

- Honestly, just a high-level practice for both sides. Starting to see things come together.

- Check back for more analysis and plays in The Athletic and on the Growler Podcast camp recap.

- The Higgins TD was a classic back-shoulder high-point in the corner against DJ Ivey. Unguardable stuff. @byjaymorrison had a perfect angle on the video.

- Tanner Hudson with the play of the day for the 2nd-team offense with a fourth-down TD against a double team from Flacco. 

- Blitz was working forcing stops with Demetrius Knight and Barrett Carter both coming up with nice plays.

📽️ Another day, another flash play for Colbie Young, although he also dropped a contested catch in the end zone. 

-Jonathan Allen with a sack. 

- No Bryan Cook, no Dax Hill, no Jalen Davis (in team) left the DBs a little shorthanded.

Beat Kendall Brooks -John Fassel got a good 10-12 minutes to work special teams mid practice -Team prd offense own 1yd line. Pollard good blitz pickup vs Marcus Harris off the edge but Ward had to throw it away. Good cov -Ridley drop on Ward pass. Just a little high. Ridley got one hand on it but couldn't bring it down -Anthony Hill Jr triggered really well and stopped the RB in the backfield. Almost a safety -Early reps at RG for Fernando Carmona -Good defense by Alontae Taylor. All over Ridley on a curl rte got the PBU -A lot of back and forth between Ward and Jeffery Simmons during team prd -Tate from Ward again. This time backshoulder over Flott for the 3rd down conversion on offense 10 yd line -Fiesta Alontae Taylor. Ayomanor tried to block him and he slung him to the ground. No hard feelings they laughed about it - Trubisky to KJ Osborn on a go rte. summary:
#Titans camp notes 8-9-2026 (2)
-Mohamoud Diabate, John Franklin-Myers, Jackie Marshall worked on a side field
-David Martin-Robinson over the shoulder catch from Trubisky. Beat Kendall Brooks
-John Fassel got a good 10-12 minutes to work special teams mid practice
-Team prd offense own 1yd line. Pollard good blitz pickup vs Marcus Harris off the edge but Ward had to throw it away. Good cov
-Ridley drop on Ward pass. Just a little high. Ridley got one hand on it but couldn't bring it down
-Anthony Hill Jr triggered really well and stopped the RB in the backfield. Almost a safety
-Early reps at RG for Fernando Carmona
-Good defense by Alontae Taylor. All over Ridley on a curl rte got the PBU
-A lot of back and forth between Ward and Jeffery Simmons during team prd
-Tate from Ward again. This time backshoulder over Flott for the 3rd down conversion on offense 10 yd line
-Fiesta Alontae Taylor. Ayomanor tried to block him and he slung him to the ground. No hard feelings they laughed about it
- Trubisky to KJ Osborn on a go rte. Osborn went up and grabbed it over Joshua Williams and Kendall Brooks
-Practice ends w/Jeffery Simmons and JC Latham back and forth after a run play. Defense had to do push-ups
full_text:
#Titans camp notes 8-9-2026 (2)
-Mohamoud Diabate, John Franklin-Myers, Jackie Marshall worked on a side field
-David Martin-Robinson over the shoulder catch from Trubisky. Beat Kendall Brooks
-John Fassel got a good 10-12 minutes to work special teams mid practice
-Team prd offense own 1yd line. Pollard good blitz pickup vs Marcus Harris off the edge but Ward had to throw it away. Good cov
-Ridley drop on Ward pass. Just a little high. Ridley got one hand on it but couldn't bring it down
-Anthony Hill Jr triggered really well and stopped the RB in the backfield. Almost a safety
-Early reps at RG for Fernando Carmona
-Good defense by Alontae Taylor. All over Ridley on a curl rte got the PBU
-A lot of back and forth between Ward and Jeffery Simmons during team prd
-Tate from Ward again. This time backshoulder over Flott for the 3rd down conversion on offense 10 yd line
-Fiesta Alontae Taylor. Ayomanor tried to block him and he slung him to the ground. No hard feelings they laughed about it
- Trubisky to KJ Osborn on a go rte. Osborn went up and grabbed it over Joshua Williams and Kendall Brooks
-Practice ends w/Jeffery Simmons and JC Latham back and forth after a run play. Defense had to do push-ups

Alontae Taylor was the closest defender -Femi Oladejo w/instant pressure from left side of the defense to force Ward to dirt it -Early reps for Pat Coogan again. IMO Austin Schlottmann has the C spot though -Jacob Martin and Solomon Thomas pressure almost sacked Ward but he threw it out of the end zone -Ward to Tate jump ball in corner of the end zone. He went up over Flott to make the catch and spiked it emphatically. Spears caught it between James Williams Sr and Kendall Brooks
summary:
#Titans camp notes 8-9-2026
-Joshua Williams (pectoral) in the yellow no contact jersey again
-Ward to Wan'Dale Robinson on quick out-breaking rte. Dropped it right over his shoulder for the comp. They continue to seem in sync
-Ward drop shot to Tate for a TD on a go rte. Alontae Taylor was the closest defender
-Femi Oladejo w/instant pressure from left side of the defense to force Ward to dirt it
-Early reps for Pat Coogan again. IMO Austin Schlottmann has the C spot though
-Jacob Martin and Solomon Thomas pressure almost sacked Ward but he threw it out of the end zone
-Ward to Tate jump ball in corner of the end zone. He went up over Flott to make the catch and spiked it emphatically. That's Tate's 2nd TD catch (over was on a quick out-breaking rte) earlier during team prd 
-Trubisky w/a strike to Tyjae Spears for the TD. Spears caught it between James Williams Sr and Kendall Brooks
full_text:
#Titans camp notes 8-9-2026
-Joshua Williams (pectoral) in the yellow no contact jersey again
-Ward to Wan'Dale Robinson on quick out-breaking rte. Dropped it right over his shoulder for the comp. They continue to seem in sync
-Ward drop shot to Tate for a TD on a go rte. Alontae Taylor was the closest defender
-Femi Oladejo w/instant pressure from left side of the defense to force Ward to dirt it
-Early reps for Pat Coogan again. IMO Austin Schlottmann has the C spot though
-Jacob Martin and Solomon Thomas pressure almost sacked Ward but he threw it out of the end zone
-Ward to Tate jump ball in corner of the end zone. He went up over Flott to make the catch and spiked it emphatically. That's Tate's 2nd TD catch (over was on a quick out-breaking rte) earlier during team prd 
-Trubisky w/a strike to Tyjae Spears for the TD. Spears caught it between James Williams Sr and Kendall Brooks

But Brandon Coleman was the left tackle of a Commanders team that made an NFC title game two years ago. He's always proven capable at tackle when he's played. Tunsil's special and he'll be missed. But this is a huge chance for Coleman to show that he's ready to be a starter in the NFL. And based on his rookie season, it's not a stretch to assume he will play well.
